name: coding-agents
description: Minimize coding time-to-completion in GUI Codex through official subagents. Trigger only when the user explicitly names Coding Agents or invokes $coding-agents; continuation is limited to that active workflow. Generic subagent coordination and .coding-agents presence do not trigger it.

interface.shortDescription: Faster GUI coding with official subagents.
interface.longDescription: Coding Agents minimizes total coding wall-clock time by mapping dependencies and the critical path before the parent GUI Codex task dispatches work. Ready, independent, sufficiently large responsibilities whose benefit exceeds coordination and integration cost start in the same parallel wave without serial delay. Tightly coupled, dependency-blocked, overlapping, or too-small work stays parent-owned or ordered. The parent retains decomposition, authority, safety, worker routing, conflict resolution, integration, acceptance, and final reporting; each worker owns one exclusive complete output. State and verification remain minimal implementation support.
defaultPrompt: Use Coding Agents explicitly: map dependencies and the critical path, then spawn ready independent work in one parallel wave.
Use $coding-agents explicitly to minimize time-to-completion, not agent count; keep tightly coupled work parent-owned.
Continue this Coding Agents workflow with parent integration, exclusive worker outputs, and minimal state and verification.
